answer: No. A fitted per-layout rule for the P/D threshold (G-L family: T=8192 at 2P/6D, T=16 at 3P/5D) does not beat the shipped T=16 as a deployable rule. It raises capacity substantially where it engages — +29.7% to +83.4% over shipped T=16 at 2P/6D on the win cells (W5t toolagent +29.7%, W1 prefill-heavy +83.4%) — but it breaches the pre-registered guardrails on held-out cells (regret failures at W5t/4P-4D and W5w/4P-4D, an attainment failure at W5w/2P-6D), so the gated-gain verdict is -100.0%: the rule does not clear the gain gate while holding every guardrail. Keep 16.
